value.rationale: The question is a motivated perfect-leader design problem for second-order stochastic consensus on the classical infinite quadrilateral-book family. It gives all optimal sets and tie multiplicities for every positive real rung weight, a universal hub-pair law across all larger pages, and one exact isolated two-page transition. At the unweighted three-page graph, optimal leader types disagree with previously reported first-order choices, evidencing genuine control-objective dependence rather than a routine renaming or tiny numerical gain.
